items.source: Set the bean that the generated map should reflect. The bean may be swapped out for another bean of the same type using setBean(Object). Calling this method overrides any value previously set using setBeanClass(Class). You must call either this method or setBeanClass(Class) before create().
items.translation: 设置生成的 map 应反映的 bean。该 bean 可以使用 setBean(Object) 替换为同一类型的另一个 bean。调用此方法会覆盖之前使用 setBeanClass(Class) 设置的任何值。您必须在调用 create() 之前调用此方法或 setBeanClass(Class)。
